messages:
mike: FYI seeing a sudden spike of 502/504s for Hosted API over the last 15m. Multiple customers reporting failures for /v1/complete streaming and non-streaming. Not in the edge deploy window but looks correlated with an auth-proxy change. sample req id: rid-7890, trace: trace-0a1b2c
jen: thanks mike — do we have regions and customer ids? any repro steps from customers?
kyle: repro from eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Customer org=org_123 sent curl + streaming logs, got 504 consistently for long responses, 502 for quick calls. Time window ~00:10-00:25 UTC.
alex: pulling metrics now — upstream retries and h2 stream resets spiked at 00:09. midproxy auth connections show frequent resets. grabbing envoy admin cluster dump.
ben: edge frontdoor is reporting keepalive pool saturation and lots of TIME_WAIT sockets on workers. Could be keepalive mismatch with auth-proxy after recent egress change.
sara: deploy-bot shows an auth-proxy rollout at 00:08 — link: https://deploys.redwood/rollouts/2026-03-17/1234 (auth-proxy: change to conn reuse settings).
mike: ok that lines up. alex — paste the cluster stats you pulled.
alex: snippet from /clusters dump:
```
cluster auth-proxy {
  cx_active: 0
  cx_total: 18000
  cx_pool_size: 200
  cx_overflow: 1200
  rq_timeout: 2.4%
  eagle_status: H2_STREAM_RESET_OTHER x 430
}
```
alex: envoy logs show upstream reset reason: "reset before headers" and a bunch of `STREAM_RESET` with code 2.
ben: that overflow number is huge — looks like new behavior is not reusing connections as expected so pools overflow and we start returning 502 to clients.
jen: any quick mitigation we can push? customer-facing note needed.
ben: I bumped auth-proxy pool size to 400 and toggled keepalive back to enabled on the egress config. Also temporarily routed guest auth calls to auth-cache fallback for affected tenants.
kyle: sending an outbound note to affected customers: acknowledging, describing transient auth-proxy change, and listing mitigation (scaled pool + rollback in progress). ETA for full fix: 1-2 hours. :thumbsup:
alex: metrics look better after the bump and routing fallback. 502s dropped from ~12% to ~0.6% in 10m across the two regions. Still seeing a handful of stream resets.
sara: we didn't deploy edge code — confirm the auth-proxy change is the only deployment in that window. deploy-bot confirmed.
ben: rolling a full rollback of the auth-proxy conn-change now (started 00:35). will monitor.
alex: plan for root cause: change altered connection reuse semantics -> more TCP handshakes -> pool exhaustion -> upstream resets -> edge returns 502/504. Next steps: full rollback, add canary for conn reuse changes, add a circuit breaker on auth-proxy pool overflow, tighten keepalive defaults and add better alerts for cx_overflow > 500.
jen: noted for support playbook: quick mitigation checklist (scale auth-proxy pool, enable keepalive, route to auth-cache fallback, rollback change), customer comms template, and postmortem assignment.
kyle: I emailed affected customers and posted an update in account channels. customers appreciated the quick mitigation.
ben: rollback finished 00:42, pool overflow numbers falling, keepalive reuse back to normal. watching for any recurrence.
mike: awesome work everyone. please file a short incident postmortem and assign to ben/alex/sara. closing the thread once postmortem link is posted. :white_check_mark:
